title: Describe, Don't Ask: Caption-Driven On-Policy Distillation for Fine-Grained Visual Perception
abstract: arXiv:2611.32463v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) often recognize fine-grained details more accurately in a relevant crop than in the full image. Multimodal on-policy distillation (OPD) methods exploit this by transferring the advantage of a crop-view teacher to a full-image student. However, their supervision relies on region-specific questions curated through an elaborate synthesis pipeline, which brings three weaknesses: (1) every region needs a question--answer pair written exclusively for it, locking training into costly QA curation that is hard to scale to unlabeled images; (2) all rollouts of a region answer the same question, so the teacher supervises only the details it asks about, leaving other visual elements in the region unsupervised; and (3) every question presupposes that its target exists, so the student becomes prone to answering even when the target is absent. translated_title: 描述而非提问：面向细粒度视觉感知的描述驱动在线策略蒸馏
translated_abstract: 视觉语言模型（VLM）在相关裁剪区域中识别细粒度细节时，往往比在完整图像中更加准确。多模态在线策略蒸馏（OPD）方法正是利用这一特性，将裁剪视图教师模型的优势迁移到全图学生模型中。然而，这类方法的监督信号依赖于通过复杂合成流程构建的针对特定区域的问题，这带来了三个缺陷：（1）每个区域都需要专门为其编写的问答对，使训练受制于成本高昂的问答构建流程，难以扩展到无标注图像；（2）一个区域的所有采样 rollout 都回答同一个问题，教师模型因此只监督其询问到的细节，而该区域中的其他视觉元素则缺乏监督；（3）每个问题都预设了目标必然存在，导致学生模型在目标缺失时也倾向于作答。本文研究如何将无标注图像转化为广泛的视觉监督（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出用图像描述（caption）取代人工构建的区域问答对来驱动在线策略蒸馏，从而将无标注图像转化为广泛且可扩展的细粒度视觉监督信号，同时避免目标缺失时的幻觉作答。
en_tdlr: Proposes caption-driven on-policy distillation that replaces curated region-specific questions with image captions, turning unlabeled images into broad, scalable supervision for fine-grained visual perception while avoiding hallucinated answers.
